description:
Mortgage rates for residential housing loans. Source: Bundesbank.

Parameters:
- start/end: YYYY-MM-DD
- recent: number of most recent periods
- limit, fields, include: "metadata"

Key response fields (German names):
- zinssatz_gesamt: average rate across all fixed-interest periods
- zinssatz_5_bis_10j: rate for 5-10 year fixed-interest periods
- zinssatz_ueber_10j: rate for fixed-interest periods over 10 years
- volumen_gesamt: new lending volume
name: macro_mortgage_lending
title: Mortgage Rates
